newsitem.title: USA: Duke sees S.C. nuke on line early next wk.
newsitem.headline: Duke sees S.C. nuke on line early next wk.

text.p: Duke Power's 1,129 megawatt (MW) Catawba 2 nuclear power unit in Clover, S.C., shut unexpectedly this weekend, will likely restart early next week, the company said Monday.
"It will be down this week. It will be brought back early next week," a company spokesman said.
The unit was shut Saturday due to a nitrogen leak, he said.
While the unit is down, plant operators will also be making repairs to the unit's component cooling system, he said.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
